info.description: Adds content files to the specified version. Each file must be under 2 GB.
info.title: Firebase Hosting API

requests.name: DELETE /v1beta1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get the specified version that has been created for the specified site. This can include versions that were created for the default `live` channel or for any active preview channels for the specified site.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the specified metadata for the specified version. This method will fail with `FAILED_PRECONDITION` in the event of an invalid state transition. The supported [state](../sites.versions#versionstatus) transitions for a version are from `CREATED` to `FINALIZED`. Use [`DeleteVersion`](delete) to set the status of a version to `DELETED`.
requests.name: PATCH /v1beta1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the specified domain mapping, creating the mapping as if it does not exist.
requests.name: PUT /v1beta1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the channels for the specified site. All sites have a default `live` channel.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{parent}/channels
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a new channel in the specified site.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}/channels
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the domains for the specified site.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{parent}/domains
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a domain mapping on the specified site.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}/domains
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the remaining files to be uploaded for the specified version.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{parent}/files
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the releases that have been created for the specified site or channel. When used to list releases for a site, this list includes releases for both the default `live` channel and any active preview channels for the specified site.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{parent}/releases
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a new release, which makes the content of the specified version actively display on the appropriate URL(s).
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}/releases
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists each Hosting Site associated with the specified parent Firebase project.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{parent}/sites
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a new Hosting Site in the specified parent Firebase project. Note that Hosting sites can take several minutes to propagate through Firebase systems.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}/sites
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the versions that have been created for the specified site. This list includes versions for both the default `live` channel and any active preview channels for the specified site.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{parent}/versions
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a new version for the specified site.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}/versions
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a new version on the specified target site using the content of the specified version.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}/versions:clone
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Adds content files to the specified version. Each file must be under 2 GB.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}:populateFiles
requests.note: Replace {{FIREBASE_HOSTING_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
